params.description: The line to change, as numbered on the order. Empty to add a line
params.label: Line
params.name: line

params.description: For a line added: the item, or empty for a line described below
params.label: Item
params.name: item

params.description: For a line added without an item: what it is
params.label: Description
params.name: description

params.description: The line's new quantity, never below what was delivered or billed on it. 0 removes a line with nothing delivered or billed
params.label: Quantity
params.name: qty

params.description: For a line without an item: its new price, for what is not yet billed. Items take theirs from the price list and pricing rules
params.label: Price
params.name: price

params.description: Moves the order's delivery date, and its lines' that had it
params.label: Delivery Date
params.name: delivery_date

actions.confirm: Ship this order, or the lines chosen? Stock leaves the warehouses.
actions.label: Ship Web Order
actions.name: web_ship

params.description: A JSON list of {line, qty, warehouse}: the order line's id, how many (empty: all left), and a store warehouse to ship it from (empty: the one the order reserved it in)
params.label: Lines (empty: everything left)
params.name: lines

params.label: Invoice it when this shipment completes the order
params.name: invoice

actions.confirm: Create the invoice for this delivered order?
actions.label: Invoice Web Order
actions.name: web_invoice

actions.confirm: Cancel this order that has not shipped? What was paid goes back: a gift card's part onto the card, the rest through the payment it came by.
actions.label: Cancel Web Order
actions.name: web_cancel

params.description: No: the refunds wait for a person to approve them
params.label: Send the money back now
params.name: approve

actions.confirm: Change this order? Promotions are priced again; what the shopper now owes is asked for, or what they are owed is sent back.
actions.label: Update Web Order
actions.name: web_update_items

params.description: A JSON list: {line, qty} (the line's number on the order; qty 0 removes it) or {item, qty} to add an item
params.label: Lines to change
params.name: changes

params.description: A JSON object: {line1, line2, city, state, postal_code, country}. Tax follows where the order now goes
params.label: New shipping address
params.name: address

params.description: Delivery is priced again for what the order now holds and where it goes: by the method it had, or the one that now applies; name one when several do
params.label: Delivery method
params.name: shipping_rule

params.label: Send a refund of the difference now
params.name: approve

actions.confirm: Cancel this order? What you paid goes back to you.
actions.label: Cancel My Order
actions.name: web_shopper_cancel

params.description: To send back only some: write each item's name or its number in the list above, then x and how many, separated by commas. Blue Mug x2, 3 sends back two Blue Mugs and one of item 3. Without an x the whole quantity delivered goes back
params.label: What are you sending back? Leave empty for everything delivered
params.name: lines

actions.confirm: Send the shopper this mail again, as the order stands now?
actions.label: Send Mail Again
actions.name: web_resend_mail

params.description: Goes to the order's own address. A mail that holds a secret value (a gift card or store credit code, the confirmation's link) cannot be sent again. The same mail goes to one order only so many times a day (Store Settings)
params.label: Mail
params.name: mail

fields.description: The line's id
fields.label: Line
fields.name: line

fields.description: Taken off the line, in the document's currency
fields.label: Amount
fields.name: amount

fields.description: The app's own id for the sale, when an app passed the promotions: recorded on one submitted document only
fields.label: Source
fields.name: source

fields.description: The app that passed it counted its use of the promotion and its code: ERP records it and counts nothing
fields.label: Counted Elsewhere
fields.name: counted_elsewhere

fields.description: Empty for a line that is not an item: a service, a fee, a one-off charge, described below
fields.label: Item
fields.name: item

fields.description: The item's name, or the line's description when it has no item
fields.label: Item Name
fields.name: item_name

fields.description: What the line is; needed on a line without an item
fields.label: Description
fields.name: description

fields.description: The item's stock unit unless another of its units is chosen
fields.label: Unit
fields.name: uom

fields.description: What the price was set for: item, unit, factor and price
fields.label: Price Basis
fields.name: price_basis

fields.description: From the price list for an item; entered for a line without one
fields.label: Price List Rate
fields.name: price_list_rate

fields.description: The exact share of the line's amount promotions take off (after its own discount), kept as text so a return gives back the same share
fields.label: Promotions' Share
fields.name: promotion_percent

fields.description: A free item a promotion added
fields.label: Added By Promotion
fields.name: added_by_promotion

fields.description: What credit notes gave back of the promotions on this line so far: the quantity and the amount per promotion, so the last part returned takes exactly what is left
fields.label: Promotions Given Back
fields.name: promotion_returned

fields.description: In stock units, at the line's warehouse when the draft was last saved: on hand less what open orders have yet to take
fields.label: Available When Entered
fields.name: available_qty

fields.description: The day the line can be delivered, from what is available and coming in, else the item's lead time; filled when empty, kept once set
fields.label: Promised Date
fields.name: promised_date

fields.description: Held for this line under the Hold reservation policy; delivering it uses the reservation up
fields.label: Reserved (Stock Units)
fields.name: stock_reserved_qty

fields.description: What could not be reserved when it was last tried
fields.label: Back-Ordered (Stock Units)
fields.name: backorder_qty

fields.description: Above the quantity when more was delivered, within the over-delivery allowance
fields.label: Delivered Qty
fields.name: delivered_qty

fields.description: What was still open on the line when the order was closed: never delivered or billed
fields.label: Closed Short
fields.name: closed_qty

fields.description: Each tax account's category and exemption reason for the line
fields.label: Tax Categories
fields.name: tax_categories

fields.description: On Item Quantity: the rate is an amount per stock unit (excise, eco and packaging fees)
fields.label: Charge Type
fields.name: charge_type

fields.description: A percentage (at most 1000); for On Item Quantity, the amount per stock unit
fields.label: Rate
fields.name: rate

fields.description: Fixed amount for Actual charges
fields.label: Amount
fields.name: amount

fields.description: For "previous row" charges (1-based)
fields.label: Reference Row
fields.name: row_ref

fields.description: Withholding taxes are deducted
fields.label: Deduct
fields.name: deduct

fields.description: The buyer accounts for this tax: worked out and reported, never charged to the party. A purchase posts it to this row's account and to the reverse-charge account; a sale posts nothing
fields.label: Reverse Charge
fields.name: reverse_charge

fields.description: Purchases: the tax owed account the reverse charge is credited to
fields.label: Reverse Charge Account
fields.name: reverse_charge_account

fields.description: For tax reports and e-invoices. When empty: Reverse Charge for a reverse charge, Standard above a zero rate, Zero Rated at zero
fields.label: Category
fields.name: category

fields.description: Why it is exempt or zero-rated: a code (VATEX-EU-132-1I) or the law's words
fields.label: Exemption Reason
fields.name: exemption_reason

fields.description: The series this document is numbered from when it is submitted: one of those set up for it (a tax invoice, a branch). Empty: the series the company's settings or its country's rules give, else the usual one
fields.label: Numbering Series
fields.name: number_series

fields.description: Follows the order's deliveries: shipped in parts, or all of it
fields.label: Fulfilment
fields.name: commerce_fulfilment_status

fields.description: The customer's; their primary billing address when empty
fields.label: Billing Address
fields.name: customer_address

fields.description: Where the goods go: the customer's primary shipping address when empty. Countries' tax rules read its country and region
fields.label: Ship To
fields.name: ship_to

fields.description: Where the goods go when there is no ship-to address: a country name or ISO code, kept as the code. Follows the ship-to address when there is one
fields.label: Delivery Country
fields.name: delivery_country

fields.description: The state, province or region the goods go, as countries' tax rules read it. Follows the ship-to address when there is one
fields.label: Delivery Region
fields.name: delivery_region

fields.description: Where the sale is made (Web Shop, Point of Sale, ...), as promotions name it; empty: this document's kind
fields.label: Channel
fields.name: channel

fields.description: Codes the customer gives, separated by commas or spaces
fields.label: Promotion Codes
fields.name: promotion_codes

fields.description: What an app that priced the sale itself (a till) says it applied: {snapshot, source, counted, at, applied: [{promotion, line, amount, code}]}. Checked against the promotion records, then kept in Promotions Applied; the lines are not discounted again
fields.label: Promotions an App Applied
fields.name: given_promotions

fields.description: The seller's and the buyer's tax registrations (label and value) and whether the buyer is a registered business, as the countries' add-ons say, kept as the draft was last priced
fields.label: Tax Registrations
fields.name: tax_registrations

fields.description: The printed order is titled Pro Forma Invoice and carries the bank details: for a customer who pays in advance or needs it for customs or a bank
fields.label: Print as Pro Forma Invoice
fields.name: print_as_proforma

fields.description: Lets this order through over the customer's credit limit; filled in by someone allowed to release credit, and kept
fields.label: Credit Release Reason
fields.name: credit_release_reason

fields.description: Taken from a gift card at checkout: the order was invoiced then, as stored value pays invoices
fields.label: Paid by Gift Card
fields.name: commerce_paid_by_card

fields.description: After the order was changed: what the shopper still owes (positive) or the store owes them (negative); nothing when settled
fields.label: Owed After a Change
fields.name: commerce_amount_owed

fields.description: A gift card covers part of the order: this much is held on it until the rest is paid; nothing is invoiced before
fields.label: Held on Gift Card
fields.name: commerce_card_held

fields.description: What the shopper's cancel and return page says of the store's terms, as Store Settings word them when the link was made
fields.label: Terms Shown to the Shopper
fields.name: commerce_after_sales_terms

fields.description: How many times the desk sent the shopper a mail again
fields.label: Mails Sent Again
fields.name: commerce_mails_resent

fields.description: The codes of the gift cards this order bought went to the shopper, once
fields.label: Gift Cards Sent
fields.name: commerce_cards_sent
